title: When Should LLMs Abstain? Chain-of-Self-Questioning for Selective Risk Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.17516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models can produce fluent answers when their factual support is weak. This paper introduces Chain-of-Self-Questioning (CoSQ), a prompt-only framework that makes answer commitment conditional on an explicit assessment of the information required to answer a question. We evaluate three CoSQ variants under seventeen conditions on the 817-item TruthfulQA multiple-choice validation set using eleven open-weight and hosted model families. In the final balanced-option protocol, Grounded-CoSQ at {\tau}=0.90 reduces the mean unconditional wrong-commitment rate from 13.1% under chain-of-thought prompting to 8.9%, a 32.1% relative reduction, while increasing answered accuracy from 86.9% to 89.7% and answering 87.6% of questions. Both improvements hold for all eleven models and at every evaluated threshold. translated_title: 大型语言模型何时应该弃权？用于选择性风险控制的自我提问链
translated_abstract: 当事实支撑薄弱时，大型语言模型仍可能生成流畅的回答。本文提出了自我提问链，这是一个仅基于提示词的框架，它使模型对答案的承诺以对回答问题所需信息的显式评估为前提。研究者在817题的TruthfulQA多选题验证集上，使用十一个开源权重及托管模型家族，在十七种条件下评估了三个CoSQ变体。在最终的平衡选项协议中，τ=0.90的Grounded-CoSQ将平均无条件错误承诺率从思维链提示下的13.1%降至8.9%，相对降低32.1%，同时将已回答问题的准确率从86.9%提升至89.7%，并回答了87.6%的问题。这两项改进在所有十一个模型及每个评估阈值下均成立。Critical-CoSQ和Adaptive-CoSQ提供了相邻的运行点，覆盖率分别为88.6%和86.5%。
tldr: 本文提出仅依靠提示词实现的自我提问链（CoSQ）框架，让大语言模型在给出答案前显式评估自身是否具备足够信息，从而在保持高覆盖率的同时将错误回答率相对降低32.1%并提升回答准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Chain-of-Self-Questioning (CoSQ), a prompt-only framework that requires LLMs to explicitly assess whether they have sufficient information before committing to an answer, achieving a 32.1% relative reduction in wrong-commitment rate while maintaining high coverage and improving answer accuracy.
